titleFromSourcePage: ESG NextGen AS2 Guide for Industry Users v2.2 — July 2026
interpretation: Section 2.1 recommends AES, supports AES-128/192/256 and says AES-256-GCM unsupported. Encryption is optional in section 2.4. Section 2.5 names MDN/ACK2/ACK3/4 but does not supply ACK schemas or a MIC algorithm.
